scripts.build:cxx-ast-runtime: npm --prefix packages/cxx-ast-runtime install && npm --prefix packages/cxx-ast-runtime run build
scripts.preversion: npm run sync:addon-optional-deps && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run build && node script/prepareVitestCpp.js && vitest
scripts.testonce: npm run build && node script/prepareVitestCpp.js && vitest run
scripts.coverage: npm run build && node script/prepareVitestCpp.js && vitest run --coverage
scripts.perf:arkts: npm run build && node --max-old-space-size=4096 --expose-gc --perf-basic-prof -r ts-node/register tests/samples/perf/main.ts --project=photos
scripts.perf:cpp: npm run build && node --max-old-space-size=16384 --expose-gc --perf-basic-prof -r ts-node/register tests/samples/perf/main.ts --project=opencv
